paper.title: Scalable Video-to-Dataset Generation for Cross-Platform Mobile Agents
paper.central_claim: MONDAY and an automated video-to-dataset framework extract diverse real-world iOS/Android interactions without manual training annotation, with robust scene detection, near-perfect UI element detection and multi-step action inference; pretraining improves mobile-agent cross-platform generalization by18.11percentage points on unseen WindowsMobile.

evidence.quote: Models that include MONDAY in their pre-training phases demonstrate robust cross-platform generalization capabilities, consistently outperforming models trained on existing single OS datasets while achieving an average performance gain of 18.11%p on an unseen mobile OS platform.
evidence.support_explanation: Original unseenOS generalization claim;18.11pp is offline accuracy.

evidence.quote: Second, we initially identify a list of actions that can be carried out on the current screen by analyzing the summaries of current and adjacent frames (two previous and two next), along with the SoM representation and narration.
evidence.support_explanation: Offline labeler sees two previous/two next frames,narration,SoM.

evidence.quote: To evaluate our data collection method, we manually annotated 100 YouTube videos, creating an evaluation dataset of 1,202 frames with 1,070 actions.

Inter-annotator disagreement occurred in only 3.93% of actions. This test set reflects a representative distribution of real-world mobile OS tasks, with touch actions comprising 67.2% of all actions, followed by scroll (19.7%), hardware interactions (7.4%), typing (3.9%), zoom (1.0%) and long press (0.8%).

To evaluate detection performance, we employ Hit Ratio as our primary metric, which assesses whether any detected bounding box’s center point falls within the ground-truth interaction area for frames with touch or long press actions.
evidence.support_explanation: Hit ratio is anycandidateboxcenter in target: oracle coverage, not targetselection accuracy.

evidence.quote: Multi-image 3-step ( Ours ) | 80.90 | 91.84

To ensure a fair comparison, all models are further finetuned using LoRA on either the AitW or AMEX dataset for an equal number of epochs, and the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss is selected for testing.
evidence.support_explanation: Equal downstream epochs, but extraMONDAY pretraining compute unmatched.

evidence.quote: During finetuning, each model receives the current screen, task name, and the last four actions as input, and predicts the next action.
Following the same annotation protocol used in the previous section, we manually annotated 50 videos containing 605 valid frames and 554 actions.

Workers found that 80.40% of 250 sampled actions were accurate, while ‘not enough information (8.60%)’ primarily stemmed from either insufficient context window coverage or incomplete user configuration details.
The total cost for identifying actions for the 20,320 videos with GPT-4o was $6976, approximately $0.34 per video.

Next, both the original and MONDAY-induced models are trained for 10 epochs on either of AitW and AMEX datasets using the AdamW (learning rate: 3e-5, batch size: 16). We select the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss for evaluation.
Typing actions are validated using flexible text matching, considering a prediction correct if the predicted text exactly matches the reference text or if either contains the other.
evidence.support_explanation: Typing accepts either-direction containment, not strict exactmatching.

evidence.quote: These actions have clear one-to-one mappings between the datasets and represent fundamental mobile OS interactions, covering 78.51% of the AitW test set, 82.60% of the MONDAY test set and 94.39% of the Windows Mobile test set.
We train SeeClick using three collections of data: web UI data crawled from the internet, mobile UI data reorganized from public datasets and general vision-language instruction-following data.
evidence.support_explanation: SeeClick already automatically constructs GUI trainingdata.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Human-audited videoextraction andauthor-reported offline actionmatching gains onunseenphoneOS,notonlineoutcomesorourreproduction.

G.reason: A concrete real-video and cross-OS data bottleneck is identified. GUI pretraining and tutorial-mining ancestors are checked, but exact earlier mobile-video methods are unavailable; no firstness credit.

M.reason: OCR segmentation, candidate detection and temporal/narrative labeling directly address distinct extraction errors, with distinguishable simpler variants.

X.reason: The collection, labeling and training chain, teacher privileges, filters and checkpoint selection can be reconstructed. A per-label correctness gate and noise-adaptive iteration are absent.

E.measurement.reason: Independent extraction annotations, disagreement rates and a separate training-label audit support resource quality. Selected transitions and offline policy matching limit the broader navigation claim.

E.causality.reason: Component ablations and same-backbone controls are useful, but extra pretraining data/compute and residual label noise are not isolated.

E.holdout.reason: Video-level splits and an unseen Windows Mobile platform support offline generalization. There is no app-held-out or online success test, and title-based decontamination is limited.

E.statistics.reason: Annotation denominators and action/category slices are reported. Training-seed repeats and confidence intervals are absent; a few totals/prose values conflict with tables.

E.cost.reason: GPT-4o labeling cost and preprocessing time are disclosed, but full search/download/GPU/training cost and an equal-compute alternative are not.

reason: Complete calibration initial review of a data/extraction resource, with scoped offline evidence.
rationale: Temporal and narrative context convert human videos into useful pseudo-labels, with component ablations and independent quality audits. Unseen-OS action matching improves, but candidate-box coverage is not action accuracy; online capability and equal-compute attribution remain unestablished.
